consequence.statement: A new optional configuration is added; the text states no operational consequence for operators who do nothing.

original.statement: A new optional Vault issuer config lets the server-name be specified when validating the certificates the Vault server presents.

decision.reason: [ev-30d2c387f95f] only says a new config option was added to the Vault issuer so the server-name can be specified when it validates the Vault server's certificates. It says nothing about existing behaviour changing, failing or needing migration. So an environment that does nothing sees no operational consequence, and "none" (informational) is the right consequence. P2's behavior-change describes the new capability, not something that happens to environments that do nothing.
